newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 23.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 23.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* In the U.S. the Dow Jones industrial average soared 173 points to close at 6,834, its second highest point gain in its history.
* Malaysian blue-chip stocks fell 7.10 points to 1,120.50 on continuing jitters caused by sharp falls earlier in the month, analysts said.
* "The Dow's strong close will provide the impetus for a slight upward bias here," said Faez Khairuddin, head of research at S.J. Securities.
